The climate control system features front dual-zone automatic temperature control and rear window defroster, allowing each passenger to set their preferred comfort level. Remote keyless entry, wireless device charging, and the power liftgate add practical convenience to everyday use.

This 2024 BMW X6 xDrive40i showcases the perfect balance of performance, luxury, and technology. We invite you to experience this exceptional vehicle firsthand and discover why it stands as a compelling choice in its class.

1989 Chevrolet K5 Blazer Custom Deluxe For Sale

This 1989 Chevrolet K5 Blazer Custom Deluxe is finished in Catalina Blue Metallic over a gray fabric interior, representing one of the last years of GM's square-body full-size Blazer before the platform wrapped up production in 1991. Silverado was the top trim on the K5 in this era, and this truck carries the comfort equipment that came with it.

Power comes from the factory 5.7L V8, running through a Jasper 4-speed automatic (4L60) and a 3.42 rear axle, sent to all four wheels through the K5's part-time 4x4 system. A Borla exhaust gives the small-block a deeper voice without straying from the factory-style combination underneath it.

The Silverado equipment carries through the cabin: power windows, power door locks, cruise control, and a tilt steering column, along with factory air conditioning that still blows cold no small thing on a truck approaching 40 years old. An aftermarket Bluetooth radio adds modern connectivity without touching the rest of the interior. Underneath, the stance has been updated with 33-inch BFGoodrich All-Terrain KO2s on 15-inch Pro Comp wheels, giving the Blazer a more capable, trail-ready look while keeping the tire size sensible for a truck that still needs to drive comfortably on pavement.

Square-body K5 Blazers like this one have drawn steadily more attention as values for the platform have climbed, and a well-optioned Silverado with a rebuilt transmission and cold factory air is the kind of truck that can be driven and enjoyed rather than parked as a garage piece.

This 2021 Chevrolet Tahoe LT in striking black combines capability with refined comfort, delivering a vehicle built for families and those who demand quality in every drive.

- Second row bucket seats with power release
- Dual-pane power panoramic sunroof
- 20" painted aluminum wheels with machine face
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Bose 9-speaker premium audio system with SiriusXM 360L
- Heated front and second row outboard seats
- 10-way power driver and passenger seat adjusters
- Front and rear park assist with rear cross traffic alert
- HD surround vision camera system
- Lane keep assist with lane departure warning
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass
- Panoramic power sunroof
- Remote start and keyless entry
- Emergency communication system with OnStar

The heart of this Tahoe is its capable EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission, delivering responsive power when you need it. Real-world driving delivers 16 mpg in the city and 20 mpg on the highway, balancing performance with reasonable fuel efficiency for a vehicle of this size and capability.

Interior space and flexibility define the Tahoe ownership experience. The second row features removable bucket seats with power release, allowing you to reconfigure the cabin for passengers or cargo. The third row splits and folds, transforming the cabin from seven-passenger seating to a substantial cargo platform. Climate control extends throughout all rows, with automatic temperature management and independent rear zone air conditioning ensuring everyone stays comfortable on longer journeys.

Technology and convenience features integrate seamlessly into daily life. The Infotainment 3 Plus system connects your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the Bose audio system delivers quality sound for your favorite content. Remote start lets you warm up or cool down the cabin before heading out, and the universal home remote provides smart home integration.

Safety runs throughout this vehicle's design. Front and rear park assist guides you into tight spaces, while rear cross traffic alert and lane change alert with side blind zone awareness help you navigate confidently. The HD surround vision system gives you a complete view around the truck, and stability control along with multiple airbags protect occupants in the event of an accident.

The Texas Edition badging reflects regional pride and capability, while the premium smooth ride suspension keeps the drive refined even over varied road conditions. Heated door mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, and LED daytime running lamps round out the practical feature set designed for dependable daily driving.

This Tahoe LT stands ready to serve families and individuals who value space, capability, and the confidence that comes with a well-equipped full-size SUV. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience what this vehicle offers firsthand.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Compatibility with myAudi and Audi connect apps allows seamless smart device integration, while voice-operated hands-free calling and radio controls enhance convenience. A built-in subwoofer ensures rich bass, making every drive entertaining and connected.

The Q8 boasts an advanced active suspension system, combined with auto start/stop for efficiency and electronic suspension control for a smooth ride. Driver-adjustable ride control and height settings let you tailor the driving experience, while full-time four-wheel drive ensures optimal traction. These features work together to offer a balanced mix of comfort, control, and performance on diverse terrains.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. 2021 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon 4x4 Billet Silver Metallic

Built for adventure and equipped with premium upgrades, this 2021 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon 4x4 is finished in Billet Silver Metallic over a Black Interior and is ready to tackle anything from daily driving to serious off-road excursions. Powered by the legendary 3.6L V6 Engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic Transmission, this Rubicon delivers the capability Jeep enthusiasts demand with the comfort and convenience you want every day.

This Rubicon is loaded with desirable factory equipment including the Black 3-Piece Hard Top, 8.4-Inch Uconnect Touchscreen with Navigation, Alpine Premium Audio System, Remote Proximity Keyless Entry, Push Button Start, Premium Audio Group, and Mopar All-Weather Floor Mats. Adding even more capability, this Jeep is equipped with an aftermarket Smittybilt XRC 9,500-LB Winch System mounted to a heavy-duty aftermarket front bumper, providing additional confidence and recovery capability when exploring challenging terrain.

Safety and convenience features include a Backup Camera, Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, Hill Start Assist, Cruise Control, and a full suite of advanced safety systems.

Originally carrying an MSRP of $53,155, this exceptionally well-equipped Rubicon offers the perfect blend of rugged capability, premium features, and iconic Jeep styling. Whether you're heading off-road, towing your toys, or simply enjoying open-air driving, this Wrangler is ready for its next adventure.

Performance is at the core of this SUV, with an active suspension system that adapts to road conditions for a smooth ride. Full-time 4WD ensures optimal grip and stability, making this BMW X5 a powerful and responsive vehicle on any terrain.

A 10.25-inch infotainment touchscreen displays real-time traffic data and integrates voice-operated commands for hands-free phone calls and radio. The sound system features 12 speakers and HD radio, delivering crisp audio quality. Additional features include internet radio via Spotify, a touch screen interface, and voice-activated electronic messaging assistance, all designed to keep you entertained and connected on every journey.

2021 BMW X4 Performance Features

Performance is at the core of this SUV, equipped with an active suspension system and electronic suspension control that adapt to driving conditions for a smooth ride. A performance exhaust enhances sound and efficiency, while auto start/stop technology helps save fuel. The full-time four-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction and stability in diverse driving scenarios. Driver-adjustable ride control allows customization of suspension firmness, providing a balanced mix of comfort and sporty handling.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
